body: Seam directions: (1) CommonViewState.feature: not a bare Checksum — a raw provider track has no FeatureDerivation, only a FeatureSpaceId. Make it Option[FeatureSelection] with FeatureSelection = Raw(FeatureSpaceId) | Derived(derivationId: Checksum); Missing stays explicit for both. I am amending ADR §3 to match. (2) V-E3 as one law: annotation.support == horizonRestrict(model.supporting(target), horizon), identity for Omniscient, drops spans ending after t for ReaderAt(t); equality in both modes against the restricted support. Atlas needs nothing more from CommonViewState (consumes selection, focus, horizon, relationLayers as-is; see view/atlas.scala). Run your cross-platform gate and commit view + seam together as proposed; I will not touch codex.scala/compiler.scala.
